novel_features.name: Order support brief
novel_features.description: See a single support-ready summary of an order with fulfillment status and inventory availability, without stitching three calls together yourself.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining order, fulfillment-order, and inventory-item data that only exists together after a local sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of separate orders/fulfillment-orders/inventory-items calls when answering a support 'where is my order' question.

novel_features.name: Bulk operation blocking wait
novel_features.description: Block until the current Shopify bulk export finishes instead of hand-polling in a loop.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps the existing currentBulkOperation query with a poll loop and terminal-state detection that no single API call provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after bulk-operations run-query when you need the terminal result rather than a point-in-time snapshot.

novel_features.name: GraphQL cost/throttle check
novel_features.description: Check remaining GraphQL query-cost budget before a heavy batch or agent session.
novel_features.rationale: Surfaces Shopify's own extensions.cost.throttleStatus block, which no other command exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before a big sync or bulk export to avoid hitting THROTTLED mid-task.

novel_features.name: Sync content diff
novel_features.description: See which rows changed content since the last sync, per resource.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local-data delta view over the SQLite store's updated_at watermarks; no live API call answers this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a weekly 'what changed' review across synced resources instead of re-scanning everything.

narrative.headline: Operate a Shopify store from the terminal with curated Admin GraphQL commands, local sync, analytics, and bulk exports.
narrative.value_prop: Endpoint mirrors for orders, products, customers, inventory items, fulfillment orders, and abandoned checkouts. A local SQLite store for offline reads, full-text search, and compound analytics (revenue, funnel, growth, ops risk, merchandising). MCP server with both stdio and HTTP transport so agents (OpenAI Codex CLI, hosted clients) consume the same surface without learning GraphQL.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN to a custom-app token with the read scopes you need (read_orders, read_products, read_customers, read_inventory, read_fulfillments). Tag mutations (orders tag, customers tag) additionally need write_orders/write_customers.

quickstart.comment: Verify-safe health check; works without auth.
Local archive state for all resources before any sync.
List recent orders with agent-native JSON.
One-call support summary: order + fulfillment + inventory availability.
Block until the current bulk export reaches a terminal state.

troubleshoots.fix: Verify SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN is an Admin API token, not a Storefront API token. Re-issue under custom-app settings.

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty results from local search or analytics
troubleshoots.fix: Run shopify-pp-cli sync --full first; analytics and search read from the local SQLite store.
Run shopify-pp-cli doctor throttle --json before a heavy batch or agent session to check remaining query-cost budget.

narrative.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs Shopify Admin GraphQL data without learning GraphQL, or when an ops/support workflow needs a joined view (order+fulfillment+inventory) that a single API call cannot provide. The MCP server exposes both stdio (Codex CLI) and HTTP (hosted agents).
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for building or deploying Shopify themes, apps, or extensions — use the official Shopify CLI (@shopify/cli) for that.
Do not use this CLI for real-time storefront/checkout interactions — it is an Admin-API operations/analytics tool, not a storefront client.
